verses.19:83: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمۡ أَزࣰّ ا

meaning: The root أزز (azz) primarily describes a state of agitation, excitement, or intense provocation. It can refer to a strong urging or incitement, often with a sense of disturbance or unrest.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic root occurring exactly twice.
